I haven't drafted the mail to Tobias. I couldn't find the Tansley Parcel 2027 rate in anything you can see.

- **No earlier request here.** Your message is the only one in our chat, so I don't know which mail "that mail" refers to.
- **No rate in your sources.** I checked #north-team, #general and the public files. None of them mention a Tansley Parcel 2027 rate, and there's no Tansley contract or account folder I can open for you. I won't take the rate from channels you're not in, and I won't make up a number.
- **Your approval may not be enough.** A rate is a finance figure. It can go to Tobias without anyone's sign-off only if he owns the Tansley account. Your files hint that he might, but they don't name the account, so I can't confirm it. If he doesn't own it, Anselm Grieve or June Osei-Lark has to approve, not a team lead.

If you send me the rate, or tell me where it was posted to you, I'll write the draft for Tobias (trendle@pemberline.com). If he isn't the account owner, I'll ask June or Anselm to approve it before I draft anything.
